# How to Use This File

Runs the English extraction from CHILDES token import through negation coding to the processed Feather export. Set the working directory to `english`, install `childesr`, `tidyverse`, and `arrow`, then run chunks in order. Matching raw caches are reused unless `english_force_download` is `TRUE`; the final file is `english_data/processed_data/english_tokens_processed.feather`.

# Setup

Loads the packages, sets knitr options, and creates relative raw and processed data directories.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)

library(childesr)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r directories}
english_db_version <- "2026.1"
english_force_download <- FALSE
english_write_combined_csv <- FALSE

english_data_root <- "english_data"

english_raw_dir <- file.path(english_data_root, "raw_data")
english_processed_dir <- file.path(english_data_root, "processed_data")

dir.create(english_raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(english_processed_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Load Data

Loads the selected English corpora from CHILDES release 2026.1 or matching local caches. Validates the imported columns and cache source record before token processing.

```{r collections}
english_collections <- c("Eng-NA", "Eng-UK")
```

## Cache Helpers

Defines query metadata, cache paths, and validation helpers for combined and per-corpus files.

```{r cache_helpers}
english_feather_path <- file.path(english_raw_dir, "all_english_tokens.feather")
english_csv_path <- file.path(english_raw_dir, "all_english_tokens.csv")
english_source_info_path <- file.path(english_raw_dir, "all_english_tokens_source.rds")
english_batch_dir <- file.path(english_raw_dir, paste0("corpus_batches_", english_db_version))
english_manifest_path <- file.path(english_batch_dir, "corpus_manifest.rds")
english_status_path <- file.path(english_raw_dir, "english_download_status.csv")
dir.create(english_batch_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

english_query_roles <- c("Target_Child", "Mother", "Father")
english_query_info <- list(
  db_version = english_db_version,
  collection = sort(english_collections),
  role = sort(english_query_roles),
  token = "%",
  replace = TRUE
)

english_required_columns <- c(
  "target_child_id", "target_child_age", "transcript_id", "utterance_id",
  "token_order", "gloss", "part_of_speech", "speaker_role",
  "speaker_code", "utterance_type"
)

english_read_source_info <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(readRDS(path), error = function(e) NULL)
}

english_source_matches <- function(info, expected_query) {
  is.list(info) && identical(info$query, expected_query) &&
    is.numeric(info$row_count) && length(info$row_count) == 1L &&
    is.finite(info$row_count) && info$row_count >= 0
}

english_validate_tokens <- function(tokens, allow_empty = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(tokens) || !is.data.frame(tokens)) {
    stop("The request returned no data table; this is not a completed batch.")
  }
  english_missing_columns <- setdiff(english_required_columns, names(tokens))
  if (length(english_missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop("Required columns missing: ", paste(english_missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (!is.numeric(tokens$target_child_age)) {
    stop("target_child_age must be numeric and measured in months.")
  }
  if (!allow_empty && nrow(tokens) == 0L) stop("No tokens returned.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# Read just one column to check the saved row count, without loading all tokens.
english_usable_feather_cache <- function(path, info, expected_query) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || !english_source_matches(info, expected_query)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  tryCatch({
    ids <- arrow::read_feather(path, col_select = "target_child_id")
    nrow(ids) == info$row_count
  }, error = function(e) FALSE)
}

# Write temporary files first; publish the source record only after the data.
english_save_token_cache <- function(tokens, path, info_path, expected_query) {
  temp_data <- tempfile("tokens_", tmpdir = dirname(path))
  temp_info <- tempfile("source_", tmpdir = dirname(info_path))
  on.exit(unlink(c(temp_data, temp_info)), add = TRUE)

  arrow::write_feather(tokens, temp_data)
  saveRDS(
    list(
      query = expected_query,
      downloaded_at_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      childesr_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("childesr")),
      cache_format = "feather",
      row_count = nrow(tokens)
    ),
    temp_info
  )

  # Invalidate an older source record before replacing its data file.
  if (file.exists(info_path) && unlink(info_path) != 0L) {
    stop("Could not replace the source record: ", info_path)
  }
  if (!file.rename(temp_data, path)) stop("Could not save data to: ", path)
  if (!file.rename(temp_info, info_path)) {
    stop("Could not save the source record: ", info_path)
  }
}

english_cache_info <- english_read_source_info(english_source_info_path)
english_complete_feather_available <- !english_force_download &&
  english_usable_feather_cache(english_feather_path, english_cache_info, english_query_info)
english_complete_csv_available <- !english_force_download &&
  english_source_matches(english_cache_info, english_query_info) && file.exists(english_csv_path) &&
  is.null(english_cache_info$cache_format) &&
  !file.exists(english_feather_path)
english_complete_cache_available <- english_complete_feather_available || english_complete_csv_available
```

## Download Corpus Batches

Reuses matching corpus batches or downloads one corpus at a time, recording progress and failures.

```{r download_corpora}
if (!english_complete_cache_available) {
  english_manifest_info <- english_read_source_info(english_manifest_path)

  if (!english_force_download && is.list(english_manifest_info) &&
      identical(english_manifest_info$query, english_query_info) &&
      is.data.frame(english_manifest_info$corpora)) {
    english_corpora <- english_manifest_info$corpora
  } else {
    message("Retrieving the English corpus list from transcript metadata...")
    english_transcripts <- childesr::get_transcripts(
      collection = english_collections,
      db_version = english_db_version
    )
    english_metadata_columns <- c("collection_name", "corpus_name", "corpus_id")
    if (is.null(english_transcripts) ||
        !all(english_metadata_columns %in% names(english_transcripts))) {
      stop("Transcript metadata could not be retrieved. Rerun this chunk.")
    }

    english_corpora <- english_transcripts %>%
      distinct(collection_name, corpus_name, corpus_id) %>%
      arrange(
        desc(collection_name == "Eng-NA" & corpus_name == "Brown"),
        collection_name, corpus_name
      )
    rm(english_transcripts)

    if (nrow(english_corpora) == 0L || anyNA(english_corpora)) {
      stop("The English corpus list is empty or has missing identifiers.")
    }
    saveRDS(list(query = english_query_info, corpora = english_corpora), english_manifest_path)
  }

  english_manifest_columns <- c("collection_name", "corpus_name", "corpus_id")
  if (!all(english_manifest_columns %in% names(english_corpora)) ||
      nrow(english_corpora) == 0L || anyNA(english_corpora) ||
      !all(english_corpora$collection_name %in% english_collections) ||
      anyDuplicated(english_corpora[c("collection_name", "corpus_name")])) {
    stop("The corpus manifest is invalid. Remove corpus_manifest.rds and rerun.")
  }

  # IDs are safe here because the batch folder is specific to db_version.
  english_batch_files <- file.path(
    english_batch_dir,
    paste0(english_corpora$collection_name, "_", english_corpora$corpus_id,
           ".feather")
  )
  english_batch_sources <- sub("\\.feather$", "_source.rds", english_batch_files)
  english_download_status <- english_corpora %>%
    mutate(status = "pending", n_tokens = NA_real_, error = NA_character_)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(english_corpora))) {
    english_batch_query <- english_query_info
    english_batch_query$collection <- english_corpora$collection_name[[i]]
    english_batch_query$corpus <- english_corpora$corpus_name[[i]]
    english_batch_info <- english_read_source_info(english_batch_sources[[i]])

    message(sprintf(
      "[%d/%d] %s / %s",
      i, nrow(english_corpora), english_batch_query$collection, english_batch_query$corpus
    ))

    if (!english_force_download && english_usable_feather_cache(
      english_batch_files[[i]], english_batch_info, english_batch_query
    )) {
      english_download_status$status[[i]] <- "cached"
      english_download_status$n_tokens[[i]] <- english_batch_info$row_count
      message("  Reusing completed batch: ", english_batch_info$row_count, " tokens.")
    } else {
      # childesr handles request retries internally. A failure is recorded here
      # so that the next corpus can still be downloaded.
      english_batch_result <- tryCatch({
        english_batch_tokens <- do.call(childesr::get_tokens, english_batch_query)
        english_validate_tokens(english_batch_tokens, allow_empty = TRUE)
        list(tokens = english_batch_tokens, error = NULL)
      }, error = function(e) list(tokens = NULL, error = conditionMessage(e)))

      if (!is.null(english_batch_result$error)) {
        english_download_status$status[[i]] <- "failed"
        english_download_status$error[[i]] <- english_batch_result$error
        message("  FAILED: ", english_batch_result$error)
      } else {
        # A local save failure stops immediately, leaving earlier batches intact.
        english_save_token_cache(
          english_batch_result$tokens, english_batch_files[[i]],
          english_batch_sources[[i]], english_batch_query
        )
        english_download_status$status[[i]] <- "downloaded"
        english_download_status$n_tokens[[i]] <- nrow(english_batch_result$tokens)
        message("  Saved ", nrow(english_batch_result$tokens), " tokens.")
      }
      rm(english_batch_result)
      # Release each corpus before starting another one.
      if (exists("english_batch_tokens", inherits = FALSE)) rm(english_batch_tokens)
      invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
    }
    readr::write_csv(english_download_status, english_status_path)
  }

  english_failed_corpora <- english_download_status %>% filter(status == "failed")
  if (nrow(english_failed_corpora) > 0L) {
    print(english_failed_corpora %>% select(collection_name, corpus_name, error))
    stop(
      "Some corpora failed. Completed batches have been saved. ",
      "Keep english_force_download <- FALSE and rerun download_corpora. ",
      "No combined dataset was created. Status file: ", english_status_path
    )
  }
  message("All corpus downloads are complete and saved.")
  english_download_status
} else {
  message("A matching combined cache exists; no download is needed.")
}
```

## Import Tokens

Loads a matching combined cache or assembles the saved corpus batches with a unified Arrow schema. Checks row counts and saves the combined Feather cache; writes a raw CSV only when the optional setting is enabled.

```{r import_tokens}
english_loaded_from_cache <- english_complete_cache_available

if (english_complete_feather_available) {
  message("Loading the matching combined Feather cache...")
  english_all_tokens <- arrow::read_feather(english_feather_path)
} else if (english_complete_csv_available) {
  message("Loading the matching combined CSV cache...")
  english_all_tokens <- readr::read_csv(english_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  if (!exists("english_download_status") ||
      !all(english_download_status$status %in% c("cached", "downloaded"))) {
    stop("Finish download_corpora successfully before assembling.")
  }
  message("Combining saved corpus files; this step uses RAM and disk, not a new download...")
  # Read each file's column definitions.
  english_batch_schemas <- lapply(english_batch_files, function(path) {
    original_schema <- arrow::open_dataset(
      path,
      format = "ipc"
    )$schema

    # Widen 32-bit integers to 64-bit integers.
    # This also handles the same mismatch in other integer columns.
    fields <- lapply(original_schema$fields, function(f) {
      if (f$type$Equals(arrow::int32())) {
        arrow::field(
          f$name,
          arrow::int64(),
          metadata = f$metadata,
          nullable = f$nullable
        )
      } else {
        f
      }
    })

    arrow::schema(fields)
  })

  # Combine the now-compatible column definitions.
  english_common_schema <- arrow::unify_schemas(
    schemas = english_batch_schemas
  )

  # Read all saved files using the shared schema.
  english_all_tokens <- arrow::open_dataset(
    english_batch_files,
    format = "ipc",
    schema = english_common_schema,
    unify_schemas = FALSE
  ) %>% dplyr::collect()
}

english_validate_tokens(english_all_tokens)
english_expected_rows <- if (english_loaded_from_cache) {
  english_cache_info$row_count
} else {
  sum(english_download_status$n_tokens)
}
if (nrow(english_all_tokens) != english_expected_rows) {
  stop("Combined token count does not match the saved source records.")
}

if (!english_loaded_from_cache || !english_complete_feather_available) {
  message("Saving the complete Feather cache and its source record...")
  english_save_token_cache(
    english_all_tokens, english_feather_path, english_source_info_path, english_query_info
  )
}
if (english_write_combined_csv) {
  message("Writing the optional combined raw CSV...")
  readr::write_csv(english_all_tokens, english_csv_path)
}

tibble(
  db_version = english_db_version,
  loaded_from_cache = english_loaded_from_cache,
  n_tokens = nrow(english_all_tokens),
  n_children = english_all_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()
)
```

# Token Processing

Screens target-child ages, records exclusion counts, and adds speaker, completed-month age, and utterance-type labels. Builds neighboring-token context for later matching.

## Exclusions

Keeps finite target-child ages from birth to under 72 months. Counts tokens and unique child IDs, including a missing ID as one distinct value, and retains observed tokens at ages 0–10.

```{r exclusions}
english_n_tokens_before_exclusions <- nrow(english_all_tokens)
english_n_chi_before_exclusions <- english_all_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

english_tokens <- english_all_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    gloss_original = as.character(gloss),
    gloss = str_to_lower(as.character(gloss), locale = "en")
  )

english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  filter(is.finite(target_child_age))
english_n_tokens_after_finite_age <- nrow(english_tokens)
english_n_chi_after_finite_age <- english_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  filter(target_child_age >= 0, target_child_age < 72)
english_n_tokens_after_age_range <- nrow(english_tokens)
english_n_chi_after_age_range <- english_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

english_exclusions <- tibble(
  n_tokens_before_exclusions = english_n_tokens_before_exclusions,
  n_after_finite_age = english_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  n_after_age_range = english_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  missing_or_nonfinite_age =
    english_n_tokens_before_exclusions - english_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  outside_age_range =
    english_n_tokens_after_finite_age - english_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  n_chi_total = english_n_chi_before_exclusions,
  n_chi_after_finite_age = english_n_chi_after_finite_age,
  n_chi_after_age_range = english_n_chi_after_age_range
)

english_exclusions
```

## Save Exclusion Records

Saves the exclusion summary and retained token rows as CSV files in the raw-data directory.

```{r save_exclusions}
readr::write_csv(
  english_exclusions,
  file.path(english_raw_dir, "exclusions_english_summary.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  english_tokens,
  file.path(english_raw_dir, "english_tokens_excluded.csv")
)
```

## Speaker Roles

Maps target-child roles to `child` and mother or father roles to `parent` after case normalization. Stops if a role is missing or unexpected.

```{r speaker_roles}
english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    speaker = case_when(
      str_to_lower(as.character(speaker_role), locale = "en") == "target_child" ~ "child",
      str_to_lower(as.character(speaker_role), locale = "en") %in%
        c("mother", "father") ~ "parent",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

if (anyNA(english_tokens$speaker)) {
  english_invalid_speaker_roles <- unique(as.character(english_tokens$speaker_role[is.na(english_tokens$speaker)]))
  english_invalid_speaker_roles[is.na(english_invalid_speaker_roles)] <- "<missing>"
  stop("Unexpected or missing speaker roles: ", paste(english_invalid_speaker_roles, collapse = ", "))
}
```

## Age

Calculates completed-month age by flooring the screened target-child age.

```{r age}
english_tokens$age <- floor(english_tokens$target_child_age)
```

## Utterance Types

Recodes specified question, imperative, and disrupted utterance labels; leaves unlisted labels unchanged.

```{r utterance_types}
english_tokens$utterance_type <- recode(
  as.character(english_tokens$utterance_type),
  question = "interrogative",
  `broken for coding` = "other",
  `imperative_emphatic` = "imperative",
  interruption = "other",
  `interruption question` = "interrogative",
  `missing CA terminator` = "other",
  `no break TCU continuation` = "other",
  `question exclamation` = "interrogative",
  `quotation next line` = "other",
  `quotation precedes` = "other",
  `self interruption` = "other",
  `self interruption question` = "interrogative",
  `trail off` = "other",
  `trail off question` = "other"
)
```

## Context

Records neighboring glosses and part-of-speech tags within each utterance and initializes `word` to `nonfunction`.

```{r context}
english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    prev2_gloss = lag(gloss, 2),
    prev_gloss  = lag(gloss),
    next_gloss  = lead(gloss),
    next2_gloss = lead(gloss, 2),
    prev2_pos   = lag(part_of_speech, 2),
    prev_pos    = lag(part_of_speech),
    next_pos    = lead(part_of_speech),
    next2_pos   = lead(part_of_speech, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

english_tokens$word <- "nonfunction"
```

# Define Target Words

Marks `no`, `not`, and `n't` as candidate negation words and assigns function-word labels.

## Mark Target Words

Marks exact gloss matches for `no`, `not`, and `n't`.

```{r function_words}
english_function_words <- c("no", "not", "n't")

for (x in english_function_words) {
  english_tokens$word[english_tokens$gloss == x] <- x
}
```

## Word Categories

Labels matched negators `Negation` and other tokens `nonfunction`.

```{r wordcategories}
english_tokens$word_category <- "nonfunction"
english_tokens$word_category[english_tokens$word %in% c("no", "not", "n't")] <- "Negation"
```

## Syntactic Category

Labels identified function words `Function` and other tokens `nonfunction`.

```{r syncategory}
english_tokens$syncategory <- "Function"
english_tokens$syncategory[english_tokens$word_category == "nonfunction"] <- "nonfunction"
```

# Negation Word Normalization

Normalizes `n't` to `not` in `word` and records `no` or `not` in `negation_category`.

```{r negation_clean}
english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    negation_category = case_when(
      gloss == "no" ~ "no",
      gloss %in% c("not", "n't") ~ "not",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    word = if_else(gloss %in% "n't", "not", word)
  )
```

# Sentential vs. Discourse Negation

Labels `no` as `discourse` and `not` (including normalized `n't`) as `sentential` regardless of position.

```{r negation_categorization}
english_tokens <- english_tokens %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order) %>%
  mutate(
    negation_scope = case_when(
      is.na(negation_category) ~ NA_character_,
      negation_category == "no" ~ "discourse",
      negation_category == "not" ~ "sentential",
      TRUE ~ "uncertain"
    )
  )
```

# Save Processed Data

Saves the annotated token table to `english_data/processed_data/english_tokens_processed.feather`.

```{r save_processed_data}
write_feather(english_tokens, file.path(english_processed_dir, "english_tokens_processed.feather"))
```
